summary: Provision scoped SA role to replace blocked iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator path in prod onboarding
description: Issue summary: During provisioning of a new Dedicated customer in prod (redwood-prod-llm-serving) the automated agent that exchanges a service account token for short-lived credentials is failing with PERMISSION_DENIED when calling iam.serviceAccounts.signJwt and iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken. Impact: New Dedicated provisioning jobs are stuck in pending state; customer onboarding blocked for one enterprise customer. Environment: production, us-central1, provisioner running in redwood-provisioner GKE cluster.
impact: Provisioning pipeline failures block Dedicated onboarding; customer cannot validate private endpoints. Multiple jobs queued (~6) and SLA target at risk.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger dedicated-provisioner job for org 'acme-corp' using the onboarding playbook.
Provisioner requests a token exchange via internal sa-proxy (service account: provisioner-worker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com).
Exchange fails with 403 PERMISSION_DENIED from IAM API when attempting iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken or signJwt.
recent_logs: 2026-03-09T18:12:01Z provisioner-worker: ERROR TokenExchange failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Request had insufficient authentication scopes.
Google IAM API: Permission iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken denied for serviceAccount:provisioner-worker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
investigation_notes: Checked IAM audit logs in Logging -> found DENY entries for iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken and iam.serviceAccounts.signJwt originating from provisioner-worker.

Org Policy 'restrictServiceAccountTokenCreator' (custom org constraint) applied to folder RedProd prohibits broad serviceAccountTokenCreator binding. This prevents cross-project token creation except for roles that have a resource-restriction condition.

Existing workaround adding roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator at project level was rejected by Security due to org policy. Hypothesis: create a narrowly scoped role bound to provisioner worker with a condition limiting resource.name to the specific service accounts used by the provisioner and restrict by requestor tag (env=provisioner).
customer_impact_details: Enterprise customer onboarding delayed; CS has notified customer and given ETA 48 hours. No data exposure observed. Customer Tier: enterprise.
proposed_actions: Create a custom role 'provisioner.tokenExchange' in redwood-prod project with minimal permissions: iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken, iam.serviceAccounts.signJwt (if needed) and iam.serviceAccounts.get.

Bind role to provisioner-worker@redwood-prod with a conditional expression: resource.name.startsWith('projects/redwood-prod/serviceAccounts/provisioner-') and request.auth.claims.env == 'provisioner'.
Submit org-policy exception request if conditional binding cannot be expressed to satisfy org constraint.
Run canary provisioning after role binding; monitor audit logs and provisioner job status.
comments: Priya Rao (Reporter) 2026-03-10: Created ticket after first failed onboarding run; forwarded logs to Security.
Rajiv (Security) 2026-03-11: Org policy prevents uncontrolled ServiceAccountTokenCreator; strongly prefer conditional binding. Will review proposed condition expression.
Ethan Martinez (Assignee) 2026-03-11: Drafted custom role and conditional binding; requesting approval to apply to redwood-prod project for canary org 'acme-corp-test'.
resolution_notes: Pending: awaiting Security approval on condition expression. If approved, we'll apply role to canary org and run two provisioning jobs. If canary succeeds, roll out to remaining queued orgs and document the binding pattern in the Prod Onboarding Runbook.
postmortem_followup: Add a step to onboarding runbook to validate IAM conditional bindings and add automated audit alert when org-policy denies token creation. Consider adding a provisioning feature flag to fallback to customer-scoped SA exchange where feasible.
notes_for_engineering: If conditional IAM binding is not expressive enough, Security recommends a short-lived exception with timebound role limited to the specific onboarding window.
Engineering to prepare a PR that adds the new role to IaC (terraform module: modules/iam/provisioner-role) and include test cases for the condition expression.
